name: ÉTOILE NOIR
description: ÉTOILE NOIR Champagne Fermented Canephora • Kaapikaadu Estate, Karnataka Not every coffee is meant to be familiar. Étoile Noir is the second release in our experimental robusta series, produced at Kaapi Kaadu Estate and processed using a champagne fermentation protocol that transforms canephora into something unexpectedly refined. The result is a cup that carries the elegance of sparkling fruit, layered sweetness, and a structure rarely associated with robusta. In the filter, it opens with bright notes of white grape, champagne, and candied pear. As the cup cools, the sweetness deepens and becomes increasingly expressive. Pulled as espresso, it shifts into richer territory with notes of demerara sugar, cacao nibs, and dried fig, supported by a dense, syrupy body. This is not a coffee trying to imitate arabica. It is a celebration of what exceptional robusta can become when grown with intent and processed without compromise. Filter Impression White Grape • Champagne • Candied Pear Espresso Impression Demerara Sugar • Cacao Nibs • Dried Fig Roast Profile Medium Light Origin Kaapi Kaadu Estate, Karnataka, India Process Champagne Fermented Varietal Canephora (Robusta) Brewing Recommendations Pour Over Coffee: 15g Water: 250g Temperature: 93°C Brew Time: 2:45–3:15 Espresso Dose: 18g Yield: 36–40g Time: 28–32 seconds Roaster’s Note The idea behind the robusta series has never been to prove a point. It has been to explore possibilities. Étoile Noir is one of the most expressive coffees we’ve tasted from this project, combining the sparkling character of its fermentation with the weight and sweetness that great canephora naturally possesses. Limited release. Roasted to order. Only while stocks last. ✨

name: MALTLINE
description: MALTLINE Some coffees taste like coffee. MALTLINE tastes like someone accidentally left a pint of craft beer beside a brew bar and discovered something special. Produced at Kaapikaadu Estate, this lot underwent a Kölsch beer fermentation before drying, creating a cup that blurs the line between specialty coffee and brewing culture. The result isn't beer-flavoured coffee. It's coffee with an entirely different kind of sweetness, structure and complexity. Expect layers of malted biscuit, golden raisin and dark honey on filter. Pull it as espresso and it transforms into notes of toffee, stout cacao and brown sugar, wrapped in a syrupy body with remarkably low bitterness. This is the second release in our experimental robusta series and one of the most unusual coffees we've roasted to date. If you've never enjoyed robusta before, start here. IN THE CUP Filter Malted Biscuit • Golden Raisin • Dark Honey Espresso Toffee • Stout Cacao • Brown Sugar WHY IT'S DIFFERENT Most robustas are selected for caffeine and body. This one was selected for flavour. The Kölsch beer fermentation introduces a deeper sweetness and a rounded, malt-like character while preserving the heavy mouthfeel robusta is known for. The cup is rich, comforting and surprisingly refined, with almost no harshness and a long lingering finish. Fermentation, processing and roast all shape the final flavour experience in specialty coffee. COFFEE DETAILS Producer: Kaapikaadu Estate Region: Karnataka, India Process: Kölsch Beer Fermented Natural Species: Canephora (Robusta) Roast Level: Medium-Light Best For: Espresso, Moka Pot, AeroPress, French Press, Pour Over FOR PEOPLE WHO... ✓ Love dark beers, stouts and barrel-aged drinks ✓ Want a coffee with huge body and sweetness ✓ Think robusta deserves a second chance ✓ Enjoy coffees that start conversations Limited Release. Once this lot is gone, it's gone.

name: OBSIDIAN
description: Obsidian Ammikulavi Estate • 96hr Anaerobic Canephora • Medium Light Roast Some coffees impress you on the first sip. Obsidian makes you question everything you thought you knew about robusta. Sourced from the mist-covered hills of the Ammikulavi Estate, this 96-hour anaerobic lot is our first release in the Robusta Series. It is rich, fruit-forward, and remarkably refined, showcasing a side of robusta that most coffee drinkers never get to experience. In the filter, Obsidian opens with notes of black grape, aged rum, and dried fig, wrapped in a syrupy body that lingers long after the cup is empty. As espresso, it transforms into layers of molasses, dark cacao, and burnt sugar, producing a dense crema and a deeply satisfying finish. Roasted medium-light to preserve its fermentation character and natural sweetness, Obsidian delivers complexity without harshness and intensity without bitterness. This is not a coffee we launched because it's different. We launched it because it's genuinely delicious. Filter Impression Black Grape • Aged Rum • Dried Fig Espresso Impression Molasses • Dark Cacao • Burnt Sugar Origin Estate: Ammikulavi Estate Region: Tamil Nadu, India Elevation: 1300–1400 MASL Species: Canephora Process: 96hr Anaerobic Fermentation Roast Level: Medium Light Brew Guide Filter • AeroPress • Clever Dripper • French Press • Espresso Roaster's Note For decades, robusta has been judged by its worst examples. Obsidian is what happens when the species is treated with the same care, intention, and craftsmanship as the world's finest coffees. One sip is usually enough to change someone's mind. ☕️

name: AMBER BLAZE
description: Amber Blaze Origin & Components: Unnaki Estate, Kaimara Estate, Melkodige Estate Tasting Notes: Caramelized Honey, Almond Praline, Red Apple Process: Honey & Washed Elevation: 3400–4800 ft Description: Amber Blaze glows with character. Built on Unnaki’s syrupy dark honey process, it flows with golden sweetness. Kaimara adds a smooth cocoa body, while Melkodige brings gentle florals and spice. Expect a rounded cup that’s rich yet refined. Caramel, Almonds, and a touch of warmth that lingers long after your last sip.

name: MOJITO
description: This lot from Melkodige Estate is our kind of experiment done right. Ripe SL9 cherries were hand-picked, floated to remove lights, then submerged with EM5 microbes for a 74-hour anaerobic ferment. After that, the cherries were moved to raised wooden trays and dried under shade for 15 days. What this really means is flavor with layers: cocoa and raisin at the core, a lift of sweet lime, and a finish that hints at cacao nib and dried dates. It’s juicy without getting wild, sweet without tasting candy-like. We roast this medium-light to keep the lime sparkle and retain the chocolatey depth that makes the cup feel complete. If you’re into expressive naturals that still behave well on brew bar, this is the one. Taste Cocoa, raisin, sweet lime, cacao nib, dried dates. Brew guide Filter: 1:16, 92–94°C, 2:45–3:00 total (V60/Kalita/AeroPress). Light espresso: 1:2.3 in 30–34s; expect a syrupy shot with citrus pop. Specs Estate: Melkodige Estate, Chikmagalur, KA Variety: SL9 Process: EM5 anaerobic natural (74-hour submerged ferment) Drying: 15 days on raised, shaded beds Elevation: 4200 ft MSL Roast: Medium-Light Best for: Filter, pourover, AeroPress; adventurous light espresso Freshness: Roasted to order. Peak from day 7–28. Reseal tight.

name: RATATONE
description: A 54-hour culture-processed natural coffee from the legendary Ratnagiri Estate. Fermented with lactic acid bacteria to bring out intense sweetness and floral depth. Expect a layered cup — bright, aromatic, and full of character. Taste Fragrant rose and jasmine, pomegranate, peach, dragon fruit Brew Guide Filter: 1:16, 92–94°C, 2:45–3:00 total (V60/Kalita/AeroPress) Espresso: 1:2.3 in 30–33s for a syrupy, fruit-forward cup Specs Estate: Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur, Karnataka Process: 54-hour Culture Natural (Lactic Fermentation) Variety: Catuai Elevation: 4300 ft Roast: Medium-Light

name: Jam Jar
description: Jam Jar A naturally processed Typica from Lam Dong, Vietnam , roasted for both filter and espresso. Jam Jar is rich, composed, and fruit-forward. Built around depth rather than brightness, it delivers syrupy sweetness with a clean, elegant finish. Taste Profile Filter Juicy, jam-forward cup with honeyed sweetness and a refined cocoa finish. Espresso Strawberry jam and dark fudge, layered with panela sweetness and a soft floral lift on the finish. Brew Recipes V60 Coffee: 15 g Water: 240 ml Ratio: 1:16 Temperature: 92–94°C Grind: Medium Brew Time: 2:30–3:00 Results in a juicy, rounded cup with clear sweetness and a clean cocoa finish. Espresso Dose: 18 g Yield: 40–42 g Time: 28–32 seconds Ratio: ~1:2.2 Thick body, syrupy sweetness, jammy fruit upfront with a polished finish. Details Origin: Lam Dong, Vietnam Varietal: Typica Process: Natural Roast: Medium Brew: Filter & Espresso Bold without excess. Sweet without noise. Jam Jar is restraint, refined.

name: CITRUS CIRCUS
description: Citrus Circus A red honey processed coffee from Koraput, Odisha, roasted as a true omni roast for both filter and espresso. Citrus Circus is playful but precise. Bright citrus sweetness meets jammy depth, balancing candy-like fruit with brown sugar warmth. It’s expressive without being loud, juicy without losing structure. Taste Profile Filter Orange candy and raisin jam upfront, layered with brown sugar sweetness and mixed berries. Soft citrus peel rounds the cup, finishing clean, juicy, and gently sweet like citrus candy. Espresso Thick marmalade sweetness with a brown sugar body. Jammy fruit carries through the shot, supported by soft berry acidity and a smooth, lingering finish. Brew Recipes V60 Coffee: 15 g Water: 240 ml Ratio: 1:16 Temperature: 92–94°C Grind: Medium Brew Time: 2:30–3:00 Results in a bright, candy-like cup with layered sweetness and a clean citrus finish. Espresso Dose: 18 g Yield: 38–40 g Time: 28–32 seconds Ratio: ~1:2.1 Juicy marmalade body with soft acidity and a rounded, sugar-sweetig sweetness. Details Origin: Koraput, Odisha Varietal: 795 Process: Red Honey Roast: Medium Omni Brew: Filter & Espresso Lively without chaos. Sweet without sharpness. Citrus Circus is controlled brightness, performed perfectly.

name: CANDY PARADOX
description: Crisp & Elegant – A Morning Symphony Tasting Notes: Spiced Caramel, Candied Jackfruit & Marshmallow Cream Origin: Kaimara Belt, Chikmagalur, India Producer: Samia Subhani Varietal: SLN 795 – AA Grade Processing: Fully Washed – Clean & Vibrant Roast Profile: Medium - Dark Brewing Recommendations: Pour-over | Chemex | French Press The Experience: From the pristine highlands of The Kaimara Belt , this washed AA-grade Arabica is a testament to purity and precision . A lively burst of citrusy brightness unfolds into delicate floral whispers, finishing with an elegant balance of sweet cocoa and golden honeydew . A perfect morning indulgence for those who savor clarity, crispness, and refined sweetness .

name: GOLDEN TITAN
description: Golden Titan Chikamagalur, KA — 100% Specialty Arabica Tasting Notes: Honeycomb, Roasted Almonds, Cocoa Powder, Toffee Process: Washed & Natural Elevation: 3500–5000 ft Description: Crafted for those who enjoy richness without the bitterness, Golden Titan is a luxurious espresso blend bringing out the natural sweetness of Indian Arabica beans. With bold notes of honeycomb and roasted almonds, balanced by cocoa powder and a buttery toffee finish, this blend offers a smooth, velvety shot with just the right crema. Designed for espresso lovers seeking complexity and comfort in every sip.

name: PURE ELEGANCE
description: Pure Elegance Blend Profile: Light, Clean, Mildly Aromatic Tasting Notes: Delicate Caramel, Floral Hints, Light Roast Crispness Roasted For: Home Brewers Best Brewed As: Espresso, Pour-Over, Filter Coffee, AeroPress Clean, crisp, and elegant — this blend is perfect for those who love coffee on the lighter, smoother side. Pure Elegance carries subtle floral notes with a soft caramel undertone, making it a refreshing cup even as a bright, clean espresso shot. Simple, refined, and effortlessly enjoyable — this is elegance in every pour.

name: BARBARA'S BAKERY
description: A Timeless Classic – Silky, Balanced & Refined Tasting Notes: Sweet Caramel, Cookie Crunch, Vanilla Malt Milkshake Origin: Chikmagalur, Karnataka, India Producer: Sreeraksha Poornesh Varietal: SLN 795 Processing: Fully Washed – Precision & Purity Roast Profile: Medium to Medium-Dark Brewing Recommendations: Espresso | Moka Pot | French Press 📜 The Experience: Sourced from the legendary Baarbara Estate , this meticulously washed coffee is a symphony of refined sweetness and deep chocolatey undertones . The bright, structured acidity shines like a well-aged wine , seamlessly transitioning into a luxuriously silky finish . Each sip unveils layers of nutty warmth , velvety cocoa, and the delicate essence of dried fruit, embodying the art of Indian specialty coffee .

name: DARK MATTER
description: Most coffee is overhyped and underdelivers. Too acidic. Too inconsistent. Too much talk. Dark Matter fixes that. Roasted deeper for strength, body, and reliability — this is coffee that hits the same way, every single day. No surprises. No adjustments. Just a solid, satisfying cup that works whether you drink it black or with milk. Taste Profile Filter Heavy, low-acid cup with dominant dark cocoa and roasted nuts. Clean bitterness, subtle caramelized sweetness, and a steady, no-nonsense finish. Espresso Bold and syrupy with thick body. Dark chocolate leads, backed by roasted nuts and a slight burnt sugar edge. Strong, punchy, and built to cut through milk without disappearing. Why This Works Built for daily drinking , not occasional tasting Low acidity — easy on the stomach Consistent every brew — no guesswork Strong enough for milk, clean enough for black This is the coffee you don’t think about. You just reach for it. Brew Recipes V60 Coffee: 15 g Water: 240 ml Ratio: 1:16 Temperature: 93–95°C Grind: Medium Brew Time: 2:30–3:00 Strong, cocoa-heavy cup with low acidity and a clean finish. Espresso Dose: 18 g Yield: 36–40 g Time: 28–32 seconds Ratio: ~1:2 Thick, chocolate-forward espresso with high body and long finish. Details Origin: India Varietal: Blend Process: Multi-Process Roast: Vienna (Medium-Dark) Brew: Filter & Espresso If your coffee needs too much effort to taste good, it’s not good coffee. Dark Matter is built to work.

name: NYOTA
description: Kiambu, Kenya — Washed Nyota — meaning star — is a bright, structured expression of Kenyan coffee at its cleanest. Sourced from the highlands of Kiambu, this washed lot is built on clarity. Expect a cup that’s precise, vibrant, and effortlessly balanced. In the Cup Filter: Red currant • citrus peel • honeyed sweetness • crisp finish Espresso: Berry-forward • lively acidity • caramel depth Details Origin: Kiambu, Kenya Process: Washed Elevation: 1600–1800 MASL Roast: Light / Omni Brew It Right Best experienced as a filter coffee to fully appreciate its clarity and brightness. Also shines as a modern, fruit-forward espresso. A clean, expressive Kenyan — built on clarity and balance.

name: CULTURED 42
description: #04: CULTURED 42 Kerehaklu Estate • SLN9 • 42hr Anoxic Washed (Inoculated) Producer : Mr. Pranoy Thipaiah A washed coffee, redefined. Cultured 42 is built on precision. 42 hours of controlled anoxic fermentation, guided through selective inoculation, transform a classic washed profile into something far more layered. This is not a loud, over fermented cup. It’s clean, structured, and quietly expressive. Expect a cup that opens with bright clarity, moves into a smooth, cultured sweetness, and finishes with a refined, lingering balance. In the Cup Filter Green apple • lime zest • floral lift Silky body with pastry like sweetness and a clean, cultured finish Espresso Caramel • almond cream • citrus peel Rounded acidity with a smooth, dessert like finish Why You’ll Love It • A modern take on washed coffee with added depth • Clean, bright, and highly drinkable • Balanced acidity with a smooth, creamy body • Built for filter, versatile enough for espresso • Limited release. Once it’s gone, it’s gone Coffee Details Origin Kerehaklu Estate, India Varietal SLN9 Process 42hr Anoxic Washed, Inoculated Fermentation Roast Level Light, filter focused Brew Guide Pour Over recommended 15g coffee to 250ml water Brew time 2:30 to 3:00 French Press 18g coffee to 300ml water Brew time 4:00 From the Drop Series Part of our ongoing drop system. Small lots, released with intent. No repeats. No mass production. Just coffee worth paying attention to.

name: RATNAGIRI NATURAL CUT
description: Fruity • Jammy • Wild Ratnagiri Natural Cut is where things get interesting. This is coffee pushed to its expressive edge—bold fruit notes, fermented sweetness, and a heavier body that lingers long after the last sip. It’s not subtle, and it’s not trying to be. Expect bursts of juicy red fruits, syrupy sweetness, and a slightly wild finish that makes every cup feel alive. This is the kind of coffee that stands out instantly—loud, complex, and unapologetically different. Not for everyone. But unforgettable for the right palate. What to Expect Juicy, fruit-forward profile Jammy sweetness with depth Heavy body with lingering finish Slightly funky, experimental character Details Origin: Ratnagiri Estate, India Process: Natural Varietal: SLN 9 Roast Level: Medium Best For: Pour Over, Aeropress, Espresso (for adventurous shots) Why You’ll Love It If you enjoy coffees that push boundaries and surprise you every sip—this is exactly that.

name: RATNAGIRI DUO – DROP 03
description: 2 x 250g • Create Your Own Expression Two distinct profiles, one shared origin. For the first time, we’re not asking you to choose. We’re inviting you to experiment. Blend the Washed and Natural in your own ratios : 50:50 for balance, 70:30 for clarity, or push it further and make something entirely yours. No rules. Just preference. What This Unlocks Build your own signature cup Adjust body, sweetness, and brightness your way Experience how small changes create completely new outcomes You can also explore each coffee individually— direct links are available below. Limited Drop Part of our 11th Drop Series Small batches. No repeats. Final Note This isn’t just a duo. It’s your blend, waiting to be created. -- RATNAGIRI WASHED CUT RATNAGIRI NATURAL CUT

name: RATNAGIRI WASHED CUT
description: Clean • Structured • Cocoa-forward Ratnagiri Washed Cut is precision in a cup. Built for clarity and balance, this coffee highlights everything a clean process should deliver defined sweetness, controlled acidity, and a smooth, structured finish. No noise, no chaos. Just a refined expression of high-elevation Indian coffee done right. Expect a cup that opens with soft cocoa and toasted sweetness, followed by a gentle brightness that keeps things lively without overpowering. The finish is clean, composed, and consistent across brews. This is the kind of coffee you reach for daily but it never feels ordinary. What to Expect Clean, cocoa-led profile Balanced sweetness with mild brightness Smooth, structured finish Easy to dial in across brew methods Details Origin: Ratnagiri Estate, India Process: Washed Varietal: SLN 9 Roast Level: Medium Best For: Espresso, Pour Over, French Press Why You’ll Love It If you like your coffee clean, dependable, and quietly impressive—this one delivers every single time.

name: HOUSE NO. 02
description: Warm Cocoa • Brown Sugar • A Familiar Finish A balanced, full-bodied espresso blend designed for everyday comfort. House No. 02 is the second release in our House Series — a lineup of coffees built around routine, consistency, and quiet familiarity. Built on a washed base from Chikamagalur, layered with arabica cherry for body, and finished with a touch of natural sweetness from Kaimara, this blend is smooth, rounded, and deeply satisfying. Expect a cup that leans into warmth soft cocoa notes, gentle brown sugar sweetness, and a full, comforting body that holds beautifully across brew styles. It’s easy to drink, easy to dial in, and hard to replace once you get used to it. Designed for everyday use, House No. 02 performs just as well with milk as it does black. Whether it’s your morning espresso or an evening cup, this is the kind of coffee you reach for without thinking. The House Series House No. 02 continues our House Series, coffees designed to be part of your everyday. Every fourth drop introduces a new House blend. Not one-offs, but evolving expressions of what a daily coffee can be. House No. 01 set the foundation. House No. 02 builds on it, fuller, smoother, more refined. With House No. 03, 04 and beyond, the idea remains the same: different expressions, same purpose. Built to stay. Refined over time. Why you’ll love it • Smooth, full-bodied cup with low to medium acidity • Warm cocoa profile with a soft, natural sweetness • Excellent crema and texture for espresso • Works beautifully with milk and black brews • Balanced and easy to dial in across methods Brew Guide Works best for: Espresso Moka Pot French Press South Indian Filter Manual Pour Over (for a fuller, richer cup) Roast Level Medium to Medium Dark Roast Who is this for? If you enjoy balanced coffees with a warm, chocolate-forward profile and a smooth, comforting finish—House No. 02 is built for your everyday. name: GRINDSTONE
description: Grindstone Dark Chocolate • Roasted Nuts • Jaggery Sweetness A bold, full-bodied blend built for everyday coffee drinkers. Grindstone is your go-to daily coffee—crafted for strength, balance, and consistency. Built using a blend of washed Arabica and canephora, it delivers a rich, heavy-bodied cup with deep notes of dark chocolate, roasted nuts, and a subtle jaggery-like sweetness. Designed for those who like their coffee strong and reliable, Grindstone performs beautifully across brew methods. Expect thick crema in espresso, a bold and comforting cup in French press, and a familiar, satisfying profile in South Indian filter coffee. No complexity. No guesswork. Just coffee that works—every single time. Why you’ll love it • Strong, full-bodied coffee with low acidity • Consistent flavour across every brew • Ideal for milk-based drinks like cappuccino & latte • Perfect everyday coffee for home or office • Beginner-friendly and easy to dial in Brew Guide Works best for: Espresso Moka Pot French Press South Indian Filter Manual Pour Over (for a stronger cup) Roast Level Medium Dark Roast Who is this for? If you enjoy strong coffee, chocolatey profiles, and a bold finish—Grindstone is built for you. Freshly Roasted All coffees are roasted in small batches at our Delhi roastery and shipped fresh. Brew it any time of day. This one’s built to stay.

name: MIDNIGHT EQUATOR
description: Midnight Equator A carbonic maceration natural from Uganda, roasted medium to medium-light as a true omni roast. Midnight Equator is precise fermentation done right. The sealed-tank process intensifies fruit clarity while preserving structure, giving the cup layered sweetness without chaos. Dark fruit leads. Cocoa grounds it. The finish lingers long and composed. This is Uganda with control. Taste Profile Filter Black cherry and plum upfront, followed by pomegranate brightness and caramelized sugar sweetness. Cocoa nib undertones add depth, finishing clean, silky, and gently wine-like. Espresso Dense dark chocolate body with stewed berry sweetness. Brown sugar richness supports a rounded acidity and a smooth, lingering finish. Brew Recipes V60 Coffee: 15 g Water: 240 ml Ratio: 1:16 Temperature: 92–94°C Grind: Medium Brew Time: 2:30–3:00 Results in a layered, fruit-driven cup with cocoa depth and refined sweetness. Espresso Dose: 18 g Yield: 38–42 g Time: 28–32 seconds Ratio: ~1:2.1 Thick chocolate body, structured fruit sweetness, long clean finish. Details Origin: Uganda Process: Carbonic Maceration Roast: Medium Omni Brew For: Filter & Espresso Fermented in control. Roasted for clarity. Built for depth

description: 1 kg | Café Espresso The foundation. Standard House is designed to be dependable in busy service environments. Balanced extraction, forgiving in milk, and stable across machines and baristas. It holds structure through the day and stays consistent across batches. A house coffee that doesn’t demand attention but earns trust.

name: STANDARD SELECT
description: 1 kg | Rotational Lot Curated, not experimental. Standard Select rotates through carefully chosen lots while maintaining a familiar structure. The profile shifts subtly with the season, but the intent stays the same: clarity, balance, and repeatability. For cafés that want variation without instability. Always recognisable. Never disruptive.

name: THE HOUSE MIX
description: The House Mix 8 × 100 g | Best Sellers Selection Can’t decide? That’s exactly why this exists. The House Mix is a rotating selection of eight of our best-selling coffees , chosen at random from everything we’re currently offering. It’s a snapshot of what people are actually drinking right now - blends, single origins, comfort cups, bright cups, bold cups. Here’s the rule: If you buy this pack again, none of the coffees will repeat until you’ve worked through the full portfolio. Every box is different. Every repeat order moves you forward. This pack is for people who like variety, trust the roastery, and enjoy discovering new favorites without overthinking. What to expect: 8 different coffees No repeats on repeat purchases Blends and single origins included Profiles ranging from cozy to bright to bold Always fresh, always current Packed fresh in 100 g bags , ideal for tasting, sharing, gifting, or building a serious home rotation. This isn’t a sampler. It’s the house showing you everything it stands for.

name: COZY COOKIE
description: Cozy Cookie A washed coffee from Yirgacheffe, Ethiopia, roasted as a balanced omni roast for both filter and espresso. Cozy Cookie is warm, smooth, and comforting by design. Built around sweetness and body rather than acidity, it brings together cocoa, nuts, and soft vanilla notes in a cup that feels familiar and easy. It’s gentle without being boring, sweet without being heavy. Taste Profile Filter Cocoa and roasted nuts lead the cup, followed by soft vanilla sweetness. The profile stays round and smooth with low acidity, finishing clean and cozy with a lingering chocolatey warmth. Espresso Caramel cookie sweetness with a chocolate-forward body. Thick, creamy, and dessert-like, supported by malted vanilla notes and a smooth, lingering finish. Especially good with milk. name: DRIFTWOOD
description: DRIFTWOOD Medium Roast Monsoon Malabar There’s something strangely comforting about Monsoon Malabar. Maybe it’s the way the coffee changes with time. Maybe it’s the sea air. Or maybe it’s because no other coffee tastes this unmistakably Indian. DRIFTWOOD is our medium roast take on the classic Monsoon Malabar profile. Instead of pushing it too dark, we roasted it slower and lighter to preserve its dense body while bringing out more sweetness, texture, and clarity in the cup. The result is low in acidity, syrupy, woody, slightly spiced, and incredibly smooth. Expect notes of cocoa nibs, toasted nuts, old cedar wood, and mellow raisin sweetness layered over that iconic monsooned depth. This is the kind of coffee that feels best during slow evenings, rain outside the window, or the first quiet cup of the day. Heavy body. Soft bitterness. Long comforting finish. Taste Profile Filter Cocoa nibs • toasted nuts • wet wood Espresso Dark chocolate • raisin • tobacco sweetness Origin Region Chikkamagalur, Karnataka Elevation 1200 MSL Variety SLN 795 Process Traditional Monsooning Roast Level Medium Roast Built to retain the signature body of Monsoon Malabar while opening up a smoother and sweeter side of the coffee. Best Brewed As Espresso Moka Pot French Press AeroPress Milk-based drinks Brew Guide Pour Over 18g coffee 300g water 93°C 2:45–3:00 mins Espresso 18g in 38–40g out 28–32 sec What Monsooning Does During monsooning, the beans are exposed to humid monsoon winds along India’s western coast for weeks. The coffee swells in size, loses acidity, deepens in body, and develops the earthy, mellow character that made Monsoon Malabar famous around the world. DRIFTWOOD keeps that heritage intact, just with a cleaner and more modern roast approach.

description: Velvet Harmony Toasted Nuts • Mild Cocoa • Brown Sugar A cozy, well-rounded blend made for your daily brew. Velvet Harmony is our take on comfort in a cup. name: DARK HONEY
description: Chikmagalur, KA | SLN 795 | Dark Honey Process | 100% Arabica This one’s for those who chase depth. Sourced from the lush slopes of Unnaki Estate, this Arabica is processed using the Dark Honey method where part of the mucilage is left intact during drying, letting natural sugars soak into the bean. What you get is a cup bursting with golden complexity. Think: honeyed apricot, dried figs, and a soft wildflower nectar finish. Roasted medium to keep the balance between fruit and body. Smooth acidity, full texture, and a lingering sweetness that doesn’t quit. name: BRUTE FORCE
description: Brute Force Chikamagalur, KA — 100% Specialty Arabica Tasting Notes: Burnt Caramel, Hazelnut Butter, Whiskey-like Depth Process: Washed & Natural Elevation: 3500–5000 ft Description: Bold.
